name: FastFDK
definition: A filtered backprojection (FBP) tomographic reconstruction algorithm that processes a stack of 2D projection images into a 3D volume, using precomputed geometric weights and a specific convolution filter for speed.
summary: FastFDK is a CPU-optimized FDK algorithm that avoids FFT overhead by precomputing geometric weights and using direct spatial-domain convolution for fast 3D volume reconstruction.
